design.question: How does the fixed cpu-decode v2 format compare with pinned CPU llama.cpp Q8_0 on one cloud CPU, at short and long decode contexts?
design.native_format: g64f16, transferred unchanged from the v2 calibration choice
design.order: Eight ABBA quartets per cell: native A0, llama B0, llama B1, native A1. Each quartet yields two chronological pairs (AB, BA) and one bootstrap block.
design.warmup: One full 128-step generation per process after loading and prefill, excluded from measured samples; every measured run rewinds to its fixed context and seed.
design.timing_scope: Complete single-token forward, LM head and greedy argmax, including forwarding the final generated token. Excludes load, prompt prefill, cache rewind, JSON output, and warmup. No native operation timers.
design.workload: Both engines prefill the same seed IDs repeated to the specified context. Each then follows its own greedy trajectory without EOS stopping. Token sequences are retained; this is matched geometry, not identical free-running text.
design.native_kernel_rule: Use vnni16 only if the cloud CPU flags include avx512_vnni, avx512bw and f16c; otherwise request auto and report the actual resolved kernel. Do not claim int16 throughput for a fallback.
design.cache: F16 K/V in both engines; no GPU layers or operation offload
design.affinity: The same first N distinct physical CPUs from native discovery for both engines; strict persistent pools. Stop the inactive process group during every other engine's timed run so idle workers cannot interfere.
design.caller_binding: Hold the original v2 public CpuBinding for the native worker lifetime. The cloud sandbox makes repeated affinity syscalls expensive; the laptop path pins per operator. This harness therefore measures kernel and threading speed without that per-operator syscall cost, not unchanged laptop CLI performance. GGML already keeps its strict caller pinned.
design.llama_build: Release, GGML_NATIVE=ON, GGML_CUDA=OFF, GGML_VULKAN=OFF, GGML_OPENMP=OFF. Actual pinned CPU threadpool, strict affinity, poll50, repack enabled.
design.native_build: Release, CPU_DECODE_NATIVE=ON, CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=-march=native. Compile inside the running container, not on the image builder's CPU.
design.pilot: Before final samples, compare flash on/off/auto using three pilot observations per setting in each cell. Select the smallest pilot median, breaking ties by on, off, auto order; retain all pilot data and exclude it from final inference. The first long-context cell also estimates remaining runtime before proceeding. This is not the laptop's nine-configuration or strongest-baseline result.
design.estimator: Median chronological paired ratio llama_seconds/native_seconds, equal to native/llama throughput for equal steps. Also report each engine's median seconds, tokens/s and min/max spread.
design.uncertainty: 20,000 fixed-seed ABBA-block bootstrap resamples, seed 20261007, 95% percentile interval for the paired median ratio. Resample eight whole blocks, preserving each AB and BA pair. Intervals are per-cell, not simultaneous; cloud host variation is not fully controlled.
design.decision: Native win only if the ratio interval is entirely above 1; llama win only if entirely below 1; otherwise inconclusive. Do not omit losing, noisy or inconclusive cells or discard performance outliers.
design.environment: Record lscpu text/JSON, CPU flags, process affinity, cgroup quota, compiler/CMake versions, library/build settings, model/config/binary hashes and container resources.
design.limits: Collect the complete matrix in one measured container, without pooling samples across containers. Stream each completed cell immediately. Complete by 07:50 PDT; no new runs after 08:00 PDT or another failure. If the run is interrupted, publish only fully completed cells, explicitly labeled as a partial matrix. Model downloads and native compilation happen in the cloud. No laptop timing claims.
